main.name: Anish Patel
main.description: Impact-driven full-stack engineer building product-facing frontends, scalable backend systems, and AI-powered infrastructure with a bias for ownership and operational excellence.
main.bio: Curiosity drives me, technology excites me, and chess keeps me on my toes. As a full-stack Software Engineer, I’m passionate about building AI-powered systems, scalable backends, and product-facing frontends that solve real-world problems. Currently at Meta working on autonomous AI agents and developer platforms. When I’m not coding, you can find me diving into emerging tech trends or strategizing my next move in a chess game. Let’s connect and build something that makes a difference!
main.contactmessage: I hope you found my profile worthwhile and to get in touch with you !

resume.skillmessage: Full-stack engineer proficient in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, and Hack/PHP, with expertise in React, GraphQL, Spring Boot, Node.js, and AWS. Experienced in AI/agent systems, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP tooling.
resume.additionalSkills: I am a dedicated and self-motivated professional, always eager to learn new technologies and build impactful software solutions.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering
education.description: Studied a variety of software engineering topics, gaining skills in programming, software development methodologies, and cloud computing. GPA: 3.3/4.0. Developed teamwork and collaboration skills through academic projects and extracurricular activities.

work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Designed and developed AuditFixer, an autonomous AI fix pipeline for Meta's Comet web platform using Claude Code, MCP tooling, and orchestrator-subagent architecture — eliminating 6-7 hours of engineering time per task across 100+ trace policies. Contributed to Comet Defense Agent (Opsmate planner-executor AI agent) for PREQ regressions across Facebook, Instagram Web, and Threads, enabling 100% autonomous root-cause analysis. Shipped GraphQL prefetching on hover for Facebook Profile tabs improving P75 Visual Completion by 175ms. Delivered Meta's Llama API evaluation platform end-to-end in 2 weeks and contributed full-stack to Meta.ai Launch using React, Relay, GraphQL, Hack/PHP, and Ent schema.

work.title: Software Development Engineer
work.description: Owned full SDLC for a cloud-native resource management microservice for Amazon Devices: built a React/Material-UI dashboard with API-integrated state management, engineered Python Lambda functions with Step Functions orchestration, DynamoDB conditional-write transactions, and API Gateway REST endpoints — reducing manual effort by 70% and errors by 60%. Engineered the Branch Retirement Request workflow for the Vulnerability Management platform (React UI + Java/Spring Boot APIs + SNS/SQS event-driven fan-out), reducing unnecessary tickets by 50%. Automated false-positive vulnerability lifecycle management via scheduled Python Lambda jobs, eliminating 7-8 hours/week of manual work. Delivered Ring iOS compliance reporting dashboard with React/Chart.js frontend and SES-templated email notifications, reducing overdue-ticket tracking time by 60%.
